finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.assumptions: The 'country' input is attacker-controlled and directly used in constructing a URL that is fetched using libcurl. If the server at 'https://www.officeholidays.com' is vulnerable to path traversal or other attacks, this could lead to unintended behavior.

finding.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
finding.assumptions: The HTML content fetched from the URL is directly parsed and displayed without proper sanitization. If the fetched content contains malicious scripts, they could be executed in the client's browser.

finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.trigger: response contains special characters that could be used in OS command injection
finding.assumptions: The HTML content fetched from the URL is directly parsed and used in constructing file paths or other OS commands. If the fetched content contains special characters, they could be used to inject malicious commands.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.assumptions: The HTML content fetched from the URL is directly parsed and used in constructing OS commands. If the fetched content contains malicious commands, they could be executed on the server.
